name: Yuzuriha Hijiri
source: Yuzuriha Hijiri embodies the stereotypical high school princess. She is a dignified, bright, and elegant young lady with a strong and well-defined fashion sense. She takes pride in her image, and carefully prepares herself, be it through morning ablutions, studying, or anything else in life. Despite her intellect, she is quite inept in the use of technology, constantly trying to circumvent her lack of understanding by requesting a simpler means of communication. When embarrassed by her own clumsiness, she will become quite flustered, resulting in agitated ramblings.
